rv.q: A sense of disconnectedness pervades everything, from the limping parade of witticisms to the performers' relationships with their roles.

cn.t: Critics find Greenberg's play a tired collection of sitcom-worthy one-liners that feel too academic or exhausted for television, suggesting a dysfunctional effort in search of a functional format.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
